name: Smart Select Filters
description: Adds a Smart Select popup to the editor delete tab with 70+ selection filters (block flags, trigger types, trigger settings, groups, layers).

close-after-select.name: Close popup after selecting
close-after-select.description: Close the Smart Select popup right after a filter is applied.

button-offset-x.name: Button X offset
button-offset-x.description: Nudge the Smart Select button horizontally in the delete tab.

button-offset-y.name: Button Y offset
button-offset-y.description: Nudge the Smart Select button vertically in the delete tab.
